faqs.q: How do you choose the best digital marketing company in Calicut for a clinic?
faqs.a: Start with what the company measures. Ask for healthcare examples, client references and how it reports results: leads, appointments or walk-ins. Check that every ad it runs shows the doctor's registration details, as the NMC guidelines require. Strong answers here matter more than a long service list.

faqs.q: How should a clinic in Calicut set its digital marketing budget?
faqs.a: Base it on your catchment, not just the city. A clinic drawing patients from nearby districts needs wider reach than one serving a few localities. Speciality and treatment mix matter too. We set spend per channel after an audit, then move it towards the channels producing walk-ins.

faqs.q: Can campaigns reach patients travelling to Calicut from nearby districts?
faqs.a: Yes. Google Ads and Meta Ads can target by town, district or travel radius, so a Calicut hospital can reach families in Malappuram, Wayanad or Kannur. The ads must still follow NMC rules, and results should be tracked to walk-ins, not clicks.

faqs.q: Should clinic ads in Calicut be in Malayalam or English?
faqs.a: It depends on who you treat and what you treat. Local, routine care may suit Malayalam, while some specialised services also draw English searches. The safest approach is to run both and compare walk-ins by language. NMC rules, including doctor registration details, apply in every language.

faqs.q: Will your team visit our clinic or hospital in Calicut?
faqs.a: Yes. Our team visits your clinic at onboarding and on a regular schedule after that. The first visit covers your front desk, call handling and Google Maps profile. Between visits, enquiries and walk-ins stay visible on a live dashboard, and calls are scored and coached.

faqs.q: What can a hospital in Calicut still advertise under the NMC guidelines?
faqs.a: Factual details are still allowed: departments, facilities, equipment, emergency services, accreditation, standard charges and a doctor directory with registration numbers. Health awareness content is also permitted if it does not solicit patients. Testimonials, offers, success rates and claims such as best are not.
